parameters.QID: local VM slice id, default STK

command.issue_at: absolute cycle of first rq output
command.drain_at: absolute first landing SRAM read cycle, >=issue_at+10; chunk i read at drain_at+i after commit at issue_at+i+9
command.cycle: 32-bit global compiler clock from static dispatcher
command.cycle_wrap: Signed modulo32 scheduling distances; each planned interval <2^31 cycles; exact equality issue slots cross counter wrap

vm.latency: rq output -> bank sample+1 -> bank rr+7 -> landing SRAM commit+9

wb.wb_ready: prior whole WB block reservation accepted, checked once at drain_at (>=issue+10); never gates schedule
wb.wa: 12-bit actual posted sector count per quadrant (group48), may acknowledge whole640/1024-sector block on true PHY completion; fence only
wb.mapping: Preserve actual global sector32. Actual PHY PC hash is s[6:2]^s[11:7]^s[16:12]; service handles mapping inside PHY boundary, never assume low5PC.

retirement.mv_src: all source data committed in actual landing SRAM; VM may be reused
retirement.mv_done: all accepted writes acknowledged, one pulse
retirement.quiet: registered no block active and all actual posted ack observed
retirement.pending_counter: bounded outstanding sector count, not cumulative accepted/ack counts

eligible: Raw FP32/U32 VM->own-stack HBM rows: sourcebase/stride64word aligned; nwhole8words; m>1 requires nwhole64words and dense HBM stride=n*4bytes (every intermediate WB beat full8lanes); <=128chunks/lane; no cross main/mirror/stack bounds
